blocks.task_summary: Find the volume of the solid formed by rotating the region enclosed by y = e^(3x/4), y = 8, and the y-axis about the y-axis.
method_path: Rearrange y = e^(3x/4) to x = (4/3) ln y
Set up volume integral π ∫ x^2 dy from y=1 to y=8
Evaluate definite integral to obtain volume
accepted_alternatives: Use x = (4/3) ln x and integrate π ∫ ( (4/3) ln x )^2 dx from 1 to 8

evidence.basis: attempt to rearrange ... to get an expression for x in terms of y OR find f^{-1}(x) (M1); x = (4/3) ln y OR f^{-1}(x) = (4/3) ln x (A1); attempt to use π ∫ x^2 dy OR π ∫ (f^{-1}(x))^2 dx (M1); π ∫ ( (4/3) ln y )^2 dy OR π ∫ ( (4/3) ln x )^2 dx (A1); = 85.6 (85.5716...) ... A1
